hooks.text: 从五十多种亡灵中征募部队，既要放大优势也要补上每只骷髅的弱点
hooks.excerpt: Draft from over 50 unique minions, each with strengths to exploit and weaknesses to mend. Experiment with synergies, adapt your strategy, and let your forces march to war.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 胜利获得骷髅货币，回城后用于黑暗仪式、训练部队与解开祖堡秘密
hooks.excerpt: Victory earns you skulls, the currency of conquest, so spend them wisely. Between battles, retreat to your castle and embrace the true work of necromancy. Perform dark rituals, train your minions, and unravel the mysteries of your ancestral keep.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 亡灵会自动交战，但死灵法师能在战中施法即时强化己方或削弱敌军
hooks.excerpt: Your minions may fight on their own, but your power reaches beyond the grave. Unleash spells mid-battle to shift the odds. Bolster your undead to weaken your foes. A well-timed spell can mean the difference between victory and another trip to the grave.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段
